### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>moby/moby (github.com/moby/moby/client)</summary>

### [`v0.6.1`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/client/v0.6.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1)

#### 0.6.1

##### Changelog

- client: add `WithHTTPRequestHook` option. [moby/moby#53671](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53671)
- client: deprecate `WithResponseHook` in favor of `WithHTTPResponseHook`. [moby/moby#53666](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53666)
- client: fix `WithHTTPResponseHook` hooks not being called for hijacked HTTP connections. [moby/moby#53821](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53821)
- client: postRaw: use consistent order or arguments. [moby/moby#53677](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53677)
- client: prevent response hooks from consuming response body. [moby/moby#53667](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53667)
- client: remove redundant cloning of response hooks. [moby/moby#53822](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53822)
- client: update github.com/docker/go-connections v0.8.1. [moby/moby#53708](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53708)
- golangci-lint: enable usetesting linter. [moby/moby#53720](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53720)
- vendor: github.com/moby/moby/api v1.56.1. [moby/moby#53837](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53837)

</details>
